name: panel-stream-grant
description: A live panel (canvas with stream): the hub's panel host opens the module's channel as a normal channel with the same grant. Frames are binary, never JSON, never through the router.

steps.event: panel visible, window not minimised; canvas node has props.stream = 'previews'

steps.why: the hub checked channel.open:foxglove.example-art/previews for its panel host (same grant as the module's channel.offer)

steps.event: hub returns {pipe, nonce} to its panel host and steps out
panel host connects to the pipe and sends the nonce first
frames flow: u32 LE length + 12-byte header + body (see frames/panel-frames.json)
panel hidden or window minimised: hub closes the channel
